presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: Four warm browns behind the thumb.
presets.description: The shape color follows the background automatically, picking whichever of black and white contrasts more, so changing the palette is enough to carry the whole picture. The thumb takes the same warm palette, since it is the subject rather than a shape sitting on one.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: Four greys, no hue at all.
presets.description: Useful for a print stylesheet, a disabled state, or anywhere color would carry meaning it should not. The shape still flips between black and white for contrast. The thumb goes grey with it; the eyes and mouth still flip to whichever of black and white contrasts more.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: A single background hue means every avatar in a set shares it, and only the thumb changes. The most restrained this style gets.

presets.name: Muted
presets.summary: Six dusty backgrounds instead of the bright ones.
presets.description: The style ships a saturated background palette. This trades it for dusty tones, for interfaces where the avatar should be present without being the loudest thing on screen.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: The other direction on the same lever: six colors past anything the style ships. The shape flips to whichever of black and white survives them.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The lightest way to make a set of avatars feel like it belongs together. The shape goes black against all five.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: The loud counterpart to Pastel Wall, strong enough that the avatar holds its own against a busy page.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the thumb.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top.

presets.name: Stencil
presets.summary: One background for everyone, only the shape varies.
presets.description: Every avatar gets the same near-black ground, so nothing distinguishes them but the drawing itself. That turns a set from a group of portraits into an icon sheet, which is what you want in a toolbar or a legend. The thumb goes near white against it.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. A list like `animation: ['glance']` plays just that one, and `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion, and a static avatar next to an animated one stays static.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: Scaled in, so the shape runs past the edge.
presets.description: Uses scale rather than color. Cropping in turns the composition from a complete picture into a detail of a larger one, which reads better at small sizes.
